items.question: Does it work with HomePod mini?
items.answer: Yes. OwnTone discovers HomePod and HomePod mini models as AirPlay 2 outputs. They must be reachable from the server on the same network or through correctly routed mDNS.

items.question: Can I choose individual speakers?
items.answer: Yes. Select any combination of discovered AirPlay speakers or automatically include every available output. Volume is configurable as well.

items.question: Can it speak my own text?
items.answer: Yes. PostPush generates the configured announcement locally with Piper, or it can play an uploaded MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, FLAC, or OGG file.

items.question: How does Home Assistant trigger PostPush?
items.answer: A Home Assistant automation publishes a non-retained message to the configured MQTT topic when the mailbox sensor detects mail.

items.question: Does the announcement leave my network?
items.answer: No. Piper creates speech locally, settings stay on the server, and OwnTone sends audio directly to speakers on the home network.
